notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, site and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 3 simply supported 40-ft bays, W16X67 + C15X33.9 girders, one 2-ton pendant crane, on new freestanding W14X120 columns with column caps, base plates, anchor rods and spread footings, and crane-level rod X-bracing; the existing building carries no crane load. Seismic: ordinary steel cantilever column system across the runway and rod bracing not specifically detailed for seismic resistance along it, Seismic Design Category B. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

selections.designed: None: end fork on the column cap (bearing stiffeners and bolted bottom flange)
selections.reason: A girder on a column cap is held by its bearing stiffeners and bolted bottom flange (fork), the top-flange restraint of the analysis: no flange tie.

Lightest W and channel cap pair within the sizing targets (ratio ≤ 0.85, deflections ≤ 0.9 of the limits): screening estimates, H1 top-flange interaction with the load-height LTB strength ratio 0.55, vertical deflection 0.70, lateral 0.13 and rail-head movement with twist 0.22 of their limits; flanges at least 8.5 in wide for the end bearing bolt gauge and the rail seat; lighter candidates rejected: 85 by cap channel fit, 203 by flange width, 1 by deflection; the next lighter, W12X58 + MC18X42.7: W flange narrower than 0.6 of the channel depth. These are the configurator's screening estimates (a simplified model that ranks the catalog), not the final ratios: the calculation checks the section and reports its own ratios.
New cantilever column for a 2-ton crane (W14X120 to 5 t, W14X159 to 12.5 t, W14X211 to 25 t, else W14X257).

fabrication.steel: W girder ASTM A992; cap channel and connection plates ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints tight (gap 1/16 in max.), supplier's joint bars (deferred submittal) installed slip-critical: Class A surfaces, bolts pretensioned, re-tightened at 30 and 90 days.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops. Cap: continuous fillet each W top-flange edge, with the end development shown. Full cap bearing contact required. Bearing stiffeners CJP to the W top flange, bottom fitted.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC. Capped girder shop sequence: weld and UT the bearing stiffener CJPs and any under-flange attachments, check the top flange flatness, then fit and weld the cap.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
